verdict.rationale: Office suites can plausibly offer scoped API credentials (cloud office suites expose OAuth-scoped APIs), so this axis applies. The evidence shows only headless mode, UNO accept strings and CLI conversion. None of it documents issuing scoped or least-privilege credentials for an agent. The read-only --view mode is an adjacent control, not credential scoping.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
